definitions.ask: Should the whole sase-core target/ build tree be deleted, not just its stale debug and release profiles?

choices.label: Delete all of target/ (~22G); the next sase-core dev-update rebuilds once from scratch
Delete only target/debug and target/release (~5G); keep the warm 16G dev-update caches

definitions.why: Everything under target/ is rebuildable; the 16G dev-update caches are mostly stale artifacts

definitions.ask: Delete the three superseded Swift 6.1.2 toolchain copies (~7.8G)?
definitions.why: swiftly reports 6.4.0 in use and nothing on apollo references the 6.1.2 copies
